marketCycles.title: Bitcoin Market Cycles

marketCycles.puellTip: Daily miner revenue ÷ its 365-day average. Under 0.5 has marked cycle bottoms; over 4, cycle tops.
marketCycles.piTip: The 111-day average crossing above 2 × the 350-day average has marked past cycle tops.
marketCycles.rainbowTip: A log curve fitted to Bitcoin's whole price history, split into 9 colour bands from Fire sale to Maximum bubble.
